metadata.description: Official Pobo Page Builder plugins for Claude Code — AI styling of Pobo Page Builder widgets, blog authoring, checking and uploading descriptions to the e-shop, content and translation checks, product labeling, product status confirmation, AI generation prompt management, scheduled nightly description automation, diagnostics of generated descriptions and bulk white label content editing on your e-shop.

plugins.name: pobo
plugins.description: Pobo Page Builder tools for Claude — AI styling of widgets, blog article authoring, product labeling from client-supplied lists, product status confirmation (draft/ready), checking finished descriptions and uploading them to the e-shop, catalogue-wide content and translation checks, AI generation prompt management with try-outs on real products, scheduled nightly description automation, diagnostics for generated descriptions, and bulk editing of white label entity content with full undo, through the Pobo MCP servers (merchant tools plus a separate white label server).
